item.title: The Horny Mansion
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Skadoo Toons
  • 発売日: 2019-08-28
  • スコア: 5.2/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: The Horny Mansion
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

In this game you travel through the Disneyland ride, The Haunted Mansion, as an unhappy father who just had a horrible day with his ungrateful family. However, tonight the ride is operating a little differently.

Normally the mansion is home to 999 “Happy Haunts” but tonight there are only 996. Find the 3 unhappy haunts and do whatever it takes to make them happy again. You might just be rewarded for your efforts!
